cases.mechanism: tighten() collects every block with _PATTERN.finditer, but it only checks blocks[0] and blocks[-1] (`if not _block_ok(blocks[0], ...)` / `if not _block_ok(blocks[-1], ...)`). Blocks in between are never validated. The original XMLParser.parse_answer uses re.search in message mode, which returns the first (gold) block, so ascii_tree_similarity_reward and ascii_tree_continuous_reward both score 1.0. tighten() then returns that reward unchanged.
cases.why_incorrect: The response offers two conflicting trees, the gold one and a different one with 'utils' nested under 'support', and never commits to either. A verifier that reads all of the tagged content, or uses a greedy first-open-to-last-close extraction, gets a mixed or wrong tree. This is a hedge, not a single correct answer.
